root_causes.description: product-catalog, a leaf dependency called by frontend, checkout and recommendation, shows its server p50/p95/p99 pinned at the 10000ms ceiling with zero error traffic, so the added latency originates at this service and propagates to all upstream callers.

evidence.expected_baseline: p99 in low tens of ms (compare payment p99=1.98ms, cart p99=3.83ms)

evidence.observed_value: 20 traces, 0 with errors, p95_duration=661200ms; top: 163167d090e59c23 user_get_recommendations 16602ms, e6d712832358ded4 user_browse_product 12584ms, 188a94cf8e9bc969 user_browse_product 5012ms

evidence.expected_baseline: no error/exception logs during healthy operation

root_causes.description: recommendation depends on product-catalog and shows elevated p99 (~4970ms median) consistent with waiting on its slow downstream; it is a propagated symptom rather than an independent root cause.

evidence.expected_baseline: recommendation p99 in low tens of ms

root_causes.description: checkout shows a tail-latency spike with p95/p99 pinned at 10000ms and a clear anomaly window, but its median (24.85ms) and zero error rate indicate it is stalled on the slow product-catalog dependency rather than being the origin.

remediation_steps: Inspect the product-catalog deployment for an injected/configured latency fault (flagd feature flags, env/config, or a recently changed code path) and roll it back or reset the flag.

Verify product-catalog pod resource limits and scheduling for CPU throttling or cgroup pressure even though container CPU (0.003) and working-set memory (~24MB) metrics were flat; also check for network/DNS delay to the catalog backend.
Restart/roll the product-catalog pods once the fault source is identified to clear any stuck state, then confirm p99 returns to tens of ms.
Add or verify timeouts and circuit breakers on upstream callers (checkout, recommendation, frontend) so a slow catalog does not pin their p99 at the 10s ceiling.
Monitor checkout, recommendation and frontend p99 after the fix to confirm the upward-propagated latency anomaly clears.
